Name: Vanilla Forage Crops and Bushes
Author: ZoeyHoshi
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/NDzSzKn.png[/img]﻿[/center]

When playing with the lovely [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20340]Growable Forage and Crop Bushes[/url] mod, did you find yourself wanting a crop for a particular missing forage item? Whether it's useful for another mod, or just pure completionism, this mod aims to add onto Growable Forage and Crop Bushes with crops for the forage items that got left out.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/qlJfxJu.png[/img]﻿﻿
[u][b][size=3]Brand New Crops
[/size][/b][/u]﻿[/center][list]
[*]Crops: [b]Cave Carrots[/b], [b]Daffodils[/b], [b]Dandelions[/b], [b]Fiddlehead Ferns[/b], [b]Leeks[/b], [b]Snow Yam[/b], [b]Wild Horseradish[/b] and [b]Winter Root[/b].
[*]Aquatic crop: [b]Seaweed[/b] (Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22975]Machine Terrain Framework[/url]﻿)
[*]Mushroom planters: [b]Magma Caps[/b], [b]Purple Mushrooms[/b] and [b]Red Mushrooms[/b] (Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20619]Custom Bush[/url]﻿)
[*]Bushes: [b]Crystal Fruit[/b] and [b]Spice Berry[/b] (Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20619]Custom Bush[/url]﻿)
[*]Fruit Tree: [b]Wild Plum[/b]
[*]Big Craftable Machine to grow [b]Green Algae[/b] and [b]White Algae[/b]
[/list]
[center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2731][b][u]For full information about how to unlock, where to buy and more about each crop, check the guide in Articles[/u][/b][/url]﻿[/center]

[center][u][b][size=3]Alternative Crop Textures
[/size][/b][/u][/center]Included in the mod folder, allows for different colour and varied flower crops. This requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] to work and if you do not want this feature, then simply delete the [b][AT] [/b][b]Vanilla Forage Crops[/b] and Bushes folder from the [b]Vanilla Forage Crops and Bushes[/b] main folder.

[center][size=3][u][b]Category Changes
[/b][/u][/size][/center][b]Daffodil[/b] and [b]Dandelions[/b] have been changed from the [b]Forage category[/b] into the [b]Flower category[/b]. This means they are able to flavour honey, has changed some gift tastes and the crops will be affected by the Tiller Profession. This is [i]enabled by default [/i]in the config.

[b][u]IMPORTANT[/u]: [/b]The Raccoon may request Pickled Dandelions in spring. I cannot change this, since it's hardcoded, so if this happens to you, go into config and disable this so that you can complete this quest.

Leeks, Snow Yams, Spring Onions and Wild Horseradish can be changed from the [b]Forage category[/b] into the [b]Vegetable category[/b]. This will change some gift tastes and the crops will be affected by the Tiller profession. This however is [i]disabled by default[/i] in the config.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/PFaqirY.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿[/center]
[u][size=3][b]Heavily Configurable:[/b][/size][/u]
Like all my mods, I've made it as configurable as possible, so you can tweak this mod to your liking and playstyle. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is highly recommended to make all config changes easier.

[list]
[*]All crops, bushes and fruit trees can be disabled, any crop you do not want you can disable.
[/list][list]
[*][b][u]Flowers Texture:[/u][/b] Change the look of Daffodils and Dandelions between the original, vanilla look or Vanilla Forage Crop style.
[*][b][u]Algae Tank Texture:[/u][/b] Change the look of the Algae Tank between original, more modern or a more rustic/medieval look.
[/list][list]
[*][b][u]Daffodils are flowers:[/u][/b] Change Daffodil category from Forage to Flowers. Check above for details on what this does.
[*][u][b]Dandelions are flowers[/b][b]:[/b][/u] Change Dandelions category from Forage to Flowers. Check above for details on what this does.
[*][b][u]Leeks are vegetables:[/u][/b] Change Leeks category from Forage to Vegetable. Check above for details on what this does. [i]Disabled by default[/i].
[*][b][u]Wild Horseradishes are vegetables:[/u][/b] Change Leeks category from Forage to Vegetable. Check above for details on what this does. [i]Disabled by default[/i].
[*][b][u]Spring Onions are vegetables:[/u][/b] Change Leeks category from Forage to Vegetable. Check above for details on what this does. [i]Disabled by default[/i].
[*][b][u]Snow Yams are vegetables:[/u][/b] Change Leeks category from Forage to Vegetable. Check above for details on what this does. [i]Disabled by default[/i].
[/list]


[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/uYtcbkA.png[/img]﻿[/center]﻿1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20619]Custom Bush[/url] and[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22975] Machine Terrain Framework[/url]. Optionally download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] as well for extra aesthetic features.
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy configurations
4. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it
5. When starting the game for the first time since installing, use Generic Mod Config Menu to configure the mod to your liking

You're all done and ready to play.
